jobPostingInfo.title: ERP Product Specialist - Oracle Fusion RtoR
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
What You'll Do:

Join a newly formed team at the core of a major finance transformation 🚀. As part of the Core Finance Tribe within our Internal IT department, you will contribute to the move from multiple custom solutions to a single, global Oracle Fusion Cloud platform ☁️.

As our ERP Product Owner Record to Report, you play a key role in shaping, delivering, and evolving our core finance solution. This is a critical, hands-on role, combining deep business analysis with strong functional and configuration expertise.

During the project phase, you support the Product Owner by challenging integrator deliverables, ensuring solution quality, and driving solid functional design.

Post go-live, you become one of the key IT owners for run & evolve, delivering enhancements and new capabilities across the R2R scope.

What you’ll do 🛠️

  • Lead or co-lead workshops with Finance stakeholders to capture and refine requirements

  • Design and document functional solutions for core finance modules (GL, AP, AR)

  • Review and challenge functional designs, configurations, and test scenarios delivered by the integrator

  • Ensure solution designs leverage Oracle standard functionalities and meet operational needs

  • Own the delivery of functional enhancements (new entities, accounting rules, payment formats, etc.)

  • Act as the functional reference for complex R2R topics and issue resolution

  • Contribute to integration design and end-to-end testing (SIT, UAT), ensuring data integrity and controls

  • Ensure compliance with IFRS, SOX, local GAAP, and internal control requirements

Who You Are:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in ERP functional roles, with strong exposure to Record to Report processes

  • You bring hands-on expertise with Oracle Fusion Finance, especially GL, AP, and AR

  • You are comfortable in a hybrid role, combining requirements workshops, solution design, and system configuration

  • You have a strong understanding of financial controls, accounting principles, and compliance frameworks

  • You enjoy investigating complex functional issues and taking ownership through resolution

  • You collaborate easily with Finance, IT, and external partners, and communicate clearly in English 🤝

We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!​

Who We Are:

We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

What We Offer:

🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.  
📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.  
💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.  
🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.  
💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.  

  

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.
